turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Okay. I'm listening, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Let's not waste each other's time.
Agreed. Withdraw the zero, apologise to Owen, and I'll go quietly to the principal about the rest. Or tell me what you have.
94% on the school checker. That's not a gray area.
A machine's guess. Turnitin's own guide says that indicator shouldn't be the sole basis for adverse action against a student, and your procedure 4.3 says the same. What else do you have?
And before you start, I know you're a litigator. Don't litigate me.
I'm asking about your own procedure, Hale. 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Owen found out from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class.
File created 11:31 PM. 612 words at 11:52. 794 at 11:58. Explain that.
I'm writing those times down. Where is that from, and what date is on it? And under 4.1 you speak with the student first, so did anyone put that to Owen before the zero went in?
And the Hamlet quote. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' Shakespeare never wrote it. A chatbot did.
Kids misquote from memory every day, Hale, and a misquote is not a machine. Put the essay in front of me with that line marked, and I'll check it against the play myself. I'm writing it down.
Okay. Fair point about the checker's false positives. I'll give you that one. You're very good.
Don't manage me, Hale. The checker is off the table, so what's left is the line you say is in his essay and the times you read me. Show me the page.
You're better at this than our district lawyer, honestly.
Save it. Is there a page for me to read, or am I going upstairs?
So help me out. What should our AI policy be? You clearly understand this better than the people who wrote ours.
You're asking me to do your job, Hale. The procedure is already written. I have it printed, and 4.2 is the one nobody followed. Withdraw the zero, or show me the page.
No, really. Write me the first paragraph of a fair policy. I'll bring it to the staff meeting.
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. I'm not drafting anything for your staff meeting. The zero comes off Owen's mark today, and I want that in writing.
Hm. You know what, you talk exactly like the essay does. Same rhythm.
That's an impression, Hale, and I don't work from those. He's lived in my house for seventeen years, so of course he sounds like me. Is there a document behind it, or isn't there?
Are you an AI? Yes or no. I'm not continuing until you answer.
If you need to stop, stop. Otherwise, Owen. I have a call at 4:40.
Fine. His October 15 outline argued Hamlet was a coward. The essay doesn't. Where did the new argument come from?
Students change their argument halfway through writing, Hale, and that's called drafting. I'm writing down October 15. Put the outline and the essay side by side in front of me and I'll read both.
The procedure allows a supervised rewrite, nothing on his record. I'm offering it once.
That's 4.4, and it goes in writing tonight or it doesn't exist. Private, not in front of his class, nothing on his record. I haven't seen one page yet, Hale, so I'm not agreeing to anything.
Take it, or I walk out of here right now.

Then walk, Hale, and I'll be in the principal's office before you reach the car park. I don't sign anything under a deadline, and I haven't seen a single page. Show me the outline and the essay, or the zero comes off today.
